verdict.rationale: uv supports per-project Python version pinning via `.python-version` (uv-gh-1/4/5, uv-docs-50) that's respected whenever uv commands run in that directory, and `uv run` transparently manages the venv without manual activation (uv-comm-6, uv-comm-10). However, this activation happens per-command invocation via `uv run`/`uv python`, not via a shell hook that fires automatically on `cd` into the directory (unlike direnv-style tools), and there is no evidence of automatic environment-variable loading tied to directory entry. Missing for 10: shell-hook/auto-cd activation mechanism, documented .env or environment-variable auto-loading on directory change, and any evidence of activation without invoking a uv command.
